leads.title: AI Chatbots Will Never Replace Advice From Elders, Say Seven of 10 in New Poll
leads.summary: More than seven in 10 Brits believe AI will never replace advice from their elders. A study of 2,000 adults found while 21 percent use these artificial intelligence tools for help several times a week, 92 percent believe some forms of wisdom can only be gained through lived experience.
